QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_32

question.text: Following 25-April-2024, a Cat III AIF may launch a new Liquidation Scheme (close-ended scheme solely to liquidate unliquidated investments of an existing scheme): TRUE or FALSE?

answer.text: True — Liquidation Schemes are the preferred route post-2024
False — SEBI has notified no new Liquidation Schemes can be launched after 25-April-2024
True — but only if 90% of investors consent
False — Liquidation Schemes were never permitted in India

explanation.text: The Logic: Although the Liquidation Scheme modalities existed earlier, SEBI has notified that no AIF shall launch any new Liquidation Scheme after 25-April-2024. The Dissolution Period now replaces the Liquidation Scheme route for dealing with unliquidated investments at scheme tenure-end. The Trap: Option A is historically plausible but factually wrong post-April-2024. Option C invents a 90% threshold. Option D ignores the pre-2024 existence of Liquidation Schemes. Note: The sunset on new Liquidation Schemes after 25-April-2024 and the Dissolution Period as the replacement route are covered in the workbook on pp. 357 and 359.
